{{Quote|Madam Speaker, it is obvious that my learned friend from Alderaan refuses to acknowledge the peril in which we find ourselves.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="From the Officials Records of the Senate of the Old Republic">{{WEGCite|story=From the Officials Records of the Senate of the Old Republic|book=The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
The '''Speaker''' was a member of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. During a period where both [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] served in the Senate together, the Speaker was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]].
